title: feat(app-shell): one save model in Studio — the package door's matrix and hooks autosave, one create label, a Changes count that keeps up (objectui#11787)
body:
Fixes #11787
Clause-②: no

## What changes

One save model in Studio, per triage's direction (option A on the package door only):

- **Permission matrix, package door** (`packageId` set; the Studio Access pillar). An edit autosaves to the package draft through the same autosave the Data and Interfaces pillars run (`useDraftAutoSave`, 1.5s after the last edit). The Save button gives way to the pillars' status line: *Saving…*, then *Saved* with the time, or the CEL refusal sentence while a CEL syntax error holds the edit. An edit taken while a save is in flight is kept and sent next (the objectui#11204 rule). The api name input is disabled on this door: the autosave stores the draft under `draft.name`, so an editable name would stage a new set at every pause while typing. "+ New" sets it.
- **Permission matrix, environment-admin door** (no `packageId`; the metadata admin route). Unchanged: explicit Save, live write (ADR-0086 D7). The autosave is `blocked` there for good.
- **Hooks** (`ObjectHooksPanel`). A hook autosaves to its draft the same way; *Save hook* is gone. A blocking CEL verdict holds the autosave (the old button's disabled condition) and the panel says why. A save writes the panel's list in place instead of re-reading it (a re-read blanked the list to "Loading…" at every pause), and the buffer install skips an unsent edit of the same hook. A hook keeps the name it was created with: while its name differs from that, the autosave holds and a line says to change it back. The draft is stored under its name, and the inspector commits the name on every keystroke, so a rename the autosave sent would stage one more hook per pause (commit `5e5adb69`, after the seat's review). Hook saves and "+ New" now call `onDraftSaved`; before, they never refreshed the Changes count.
- **Create dialogs.** *New permission set* says *Save as draft* (`engine.studio.createDraft`) like the others.
- **Changes count.** A draft save calls `refresh({ afterSave: true })` on the shared pending-drafts hook: that read is sent fresh, never joined to a `_drafts` read already on the wire (objectui#11797's sharing would answer it with a pre-save count), and `behindSave` holds until a read sent after the save answers. The header counts at least one while `behindSave` holds, so "No drafts pending publish" never shows in the same render as an item's "Unpublished draft" chip.

`useDraftAutoSave` / `DraftSend` / `draftSnapshotKey` moved out of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` unchanged, into `studio-design/useDraftAutoSave.ts`, because the matrix cannot import the surface: the surface imports the matrix, and the metadata-admin route loads the matrix without the surface. Three en+zh row pairs in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`engine.studio.create`, `engine.studio.hooks.save`, `engine.studio.hooks.saved`) are deleted: this diff removed their last readers.

**File surface.** The claim (`6072832674`) plus its amendment `6073736188`, which adds the new `useDraftAutoSave.ts` module, the moved block's removal from `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, and the three i18n row-pair deletions. No export, prop, type or language-pack key of the package entry changes: `src/index.ts` names none of the changed internals, and the exports map is `.` and `./styles.css` only.

## Premise checks (measured on `origin/main` `f0268ad78`)

- The door is `packageId`: set only by the Studio Access pillar's embed; the metadata-admin registry renders the page with `type` and `name` only.
- The pillars' debounce is `useDraftAutoSave`, module-private in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` before this change. It is reused, not duplicated.
- **Falsified:** "a hook rule is held until it has a condition (objectui#11820)". objectui#11820 on hooks is the target picker's reach (`HookTargetScopeContext`); the condition-hold is the *validation rule's* (`ObjectValidationsPanel.newRuleWaits-11820`). A hook's `condition` is optional. The only hold a hook had is the CEL verdict that disabled *Save hook*, and that is what holds the autosave now.
- Changes count, two causes: the hooks panel never reported its saves to the surface, and the save's refresh could join a `_drafts` read sent before the save. Every other draft save path already called `onDraftSaved`.

## Create dialogs and their labels

The five `CreateItemDialog` call sites at this head, all in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, now submit with `engine.studio.createDraft`: Create app, Interfaces create (page / dashboard / report), New object, New automation, and New permission set (the one that said *Create*). `CreateItemDialog.oneLabel-11787.test.ts` enumerates the call sites from source, so a dialog added later is asked too. Not a `CreateItemDialog`: *New package* (`PackageFormDialog`) creates a live package record, not a draft, and keeps its label.

## Tests

At head `bfe6edc13`, under the shared verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/` gave `Test Files 1217 passed | 1 skipped (1218)`, `Tests 11780 passed | 9 skipped (11789)`; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (its test project lists all five new test files). Gates run locally, each exit 0: eslint on the changed files (0 errors, no new warning against the base), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check-changeset-presence`. Not measured locally: the eager-closure budget (it needs a full console build); CI's Bundle Analysis reads it.

New pins: `PermissionMatrixEditor.autosave-11787` (package door autosaves; environment door sends nothing after 2.2s, then its Save writes live; in-flight edit kept; name fixed on the package door only), `ObjectHooksPanel.autosave-11787` (autosave, `onDraftSaved` on save and "+ New", in-flight edit kept, a renamed hook held and saved again once its name is restored), `ObjectHooksPanel.celGate` (rewritten: a malformed guard is held and never sent), `usePendingDrafts.afterSave-11787`, `StudioDesignSurface.changesCount-11787`, `CreateItemDialog.oneLabel-11787`. The package-door Save clicks in the existing matrix suites wait for the autosave instead.

Reverse verification through `ablation-replace` (each restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- door gate removed from `blocked` ⇒ the environment-door pin red (saved length 1, expected 0), 4 others green;
- the in-flight drop removed from `refresh({ afterSave })` ⇒ 2 red (one request on the wire, expected 2);
- `behindSave` forced false ⇒ 3 red (the header shows "No drafts pending publish" after the save);
- the CEL hold removed from the hooks autosave ⇒ the held-hook pin red;
- the hooks buffer-install skip removed ⇒ the hooks in-flight pin red;
- the matrix in-flight branch disabled ⇒ the matrix in-flight pin red;
- the Access dialog label reverted ⇒ 3 red (both label pins and the count pin's dialog click);
- at `5e5adb69`, the rename hold removed from `blocked` ⇒ the rename pin red (save called 2 times, expected never). Re-run at `5e5adb69`: the 248 test files that import `ObjectHooksPanel` or the designer table, all passed (2,259 tests), and the app-shell type-check exited 0; CI runs the full suite.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding (reported to the seat, not fixed here):** the header reads an unanswered or failed first `_drafts` read as zero. `usePendingDrafts` returns `null` for unknown so a surface can tell unknown from zero, and the header's `hasPending` treats `null` as `0`, so it shows "No drafts pending publish" while the count is unknown. Measured in the `StudioDesignSurface.changesCount-11787` harness before the save, with the mount read held.
- An autosaved hook with its last event unticked or its target emptied is sent and refused (422) rather than held; the objectui#11786 held pattern covers objects, flows and dashboards, not hooks. Not filed.
- Renaming an existing hook is held, not saved, because its draft is stored under its name. On `bfe6edc1`, before the hold, an autosaved rename typed with one 1.6 s pause staged `hook/audit` and `hook/audit_trail` beside `guard_hook`. The Actions pillar, measured the same way, overwrote one object draft, so no other pillar stages an item per pause.
- `ObjectListViewInspector` restates the `DraftSend` shape locally because the hook was module-private; it can import it now. Not filed.
